subject: Routing update: split-leg flights + charter shuttle for EdgeStream workshop
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: EdgeStream Ops <ops@edgestream.com>, Javier Ramos <j.ramos@skyways.co>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Routing update: split-leg flights + charter shuttle for EdgeStream workshop

Team / EdgeStream ops —

Quick read: final routing proposal to get 28 attendees (Redwood + EdgeStream execs) on site for the April 19 workshop in Portland with a 9:00 AM start. We had three constraints: avoid red-eye arrivals, keep same-day returns for most attendees, and ensure a single ground-load window so the shuttle can depart from PDX in one trip.

Proposal highlights (attached: edgestream_itinerary_v3.pdf):
- Split-leg routing out of SFO: 16 pax on AS 123 (SFO->SEA 07:15-08:55, SEA->PDX 10:20-11:10). 12 pax on AS 445 (SFO->PDX nonstop 08:00-09:30) to minimize connections for execs.
- Charter shuttle: book a 45-seat coach departing PDX at 11:45 to arrive at venue by 12:20. Draft manifest attached (charter_manifest_draft.csv).
- Return: consolidated evening returns between 18:00-21:30; PNR consolidation recommended to reduce per-ticket fees (see pnr_list_upd_0407.xlsx).

Ask: Lauren — can you confirm we have approval to reissue the 12 nonstop tickets (these require a fare difference + reissue fee)? Marcus — please confirm the execs who must have nonstop routing. EdgeStream ops / Karen — any constraints on arrival windows for your team (hotel check-in, VIP pickup)?

If all good, I'll instruct travel to reprice and lock the charter by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
mobile: +1-415-555-0132

Attachments: edgestream_itinerary_v3.pdf (pdf, 240KB), charter_manifest_draft.csv (csv, 3KB), pnr_list_upd_0407.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)
